title: Kase-san and Yamada
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: This sequel follows an established couple into college in Tokyo: Yamada studies horticulture while Kase trains at a sports university. With busy schedules and a long train ride between them, they work through jealousy, insecurity and a secret relationship by talking things out, supported by friends.
life_message: A healthy relationship is built by patience, honest communication and support for each other's goals.

content.note: Established same-sex couple dating, jealousy and a love triangle tag (AniList, MU); explicitness not documented (to verify).
Yamada's insecurity and internalized pressure to hide feelings (Anime Feminist).

folkways.japan: Yamada's early impulse to downplay her feelings reflects social pressure in a small Japanese town, which the story describes rather than endorses.

delivery.evidence: Anime Feminist calls the series simple and sweet but educational, modelling communication through everyday scenes rather than lessons.

winners_losers: Yamada and Kase's relationship deepens; jealousy and insecurity are resolved by talking. Friends are supportive, and no character voices opposition in the sources (Anime Feminist feature).
